propositions: The FAIL remediation guidance at completion.py:48-65 directs callers to add ticket-comment evidence on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite required by ADR 0043 for external (non-codebase-verifiable) criteria.

An operator followed the incomplete guidance by adding a ticket comment to an untagged external criterion, triggering a second verifier run that correctly rejected the evidence per ADR 0043's strict-tag semantics, wasting 240 requests.

The remediation guidance must affirmatively state both evidence channels: repository-verifiable criteria require repository evidence, while external evidence is admissible only when the criterion begins with the exact [operator-attested] tag.
The strengthened interface test for FAIL remediation must enforce the [operator-attested] tag prerequisite and the untagged-external limitation to prevent future contract drift.
